description: Generate a video with Veo 3.1, Grok Imagine or Omni Flash. Generation usually takes 1-5 minutes, longer than a tool call can wait — if it is still running when the wait budget runs out, this returns a task id to check later with check_job. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video (pass reference_images).

reference_images.description: HTTPS or data: URLs to guide generation (image-to-video).

size.description: Pixel size as "WxH", e.g. "1280x720". Aspect ratio is inferred from it.

tier.description: Resolution tier. Worth setting: pricing is per tier, and a size matching no tier falls back to the model's base rate.

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video
